purpose: Matched optimizer-step comparison of a copied no-signal CNN fit on real TRAIN only versus the same budget with a fixed fraction of sibling synthetic windows mixed into each batch. Public validation is scored on the tune split only.
reads_only: experiments/mlp_cnn_hpo/source/train.py (tune-only score pattern; file not copied because it defines an MLP and a final export)
kit/public/validation for tune queries and official tune score
not_trained: anything fit on tune, confirm, or test

model.reason_constant_lr: The stated learning rate is the AdamW learning rate on every step. Step count is the budget, so a one-cycle schedule is not used.

batch.exposure_definition: A completed trial performs exactly `steps` AdamW updates. Each update consumes exactly `batch_size` windows. Trials with the same step count have the same number of window exposures. Epoch count is not the budget.
batch.mix_definition: n_synth = round(mix * batch_size), n_real = batch_size - n_synth. Real columns are the leading columns of the real-only index plan for that trial seed, drawn with numpy Generator(seed) as integers in [0, n_real_windows). Synthetic columns use numpy Generator(seed + 9176).
batch.initialization: For each trial seed, CNN weights are drawn once with torch.manual_seed(seed) and reloaded at the start of every trial with that seed. After the reload, torch.manual_seed(seed) resets the dropout stream. Dropout probability is 0.1.

windows.input: Right-aligned payout-index window of ticks in [t-W, t). Positions with no observation are MISSING (-1), never payout 0. The same episode supplies all 8 machines. machine_id is slot 0..7 and is not re-sorted.
windows.target: Sampled payout index at tick t for slots with observed=true. Unobserved slots are masked out of the loss. Truth probability vectors are not targets.
windows.signal: Not read and not synthesized. CNN is constructed with use_signal=false.

real_fit: kit/public/train only, via the copied build_train. Train query outcomes at the cutoff are train labels. Validation rows are never concatenated into the fit tensors.

evaluation.metric: official score_predictions R (mean loss ratio versus the frozen reference; lower is better)
evaluation.confirm: loaded only to assert the scored episode set is disjoint from confirm; confirm R is not computed

generators.record_cap_fallback: If the family refuses that size, retry generate(seed=0, n_episodes=8, n_ticks=96, n_machines=8). Generation seed stays 0 for every trial seed so seed 1 is a second init and batch-order replicate on the same frozen panel.
generators.skip: Missing generate.py at screen close, or a settled file that raises, is skipped. The stored error is the exception type and message plus the traceback. A changed source hash is retried. Half-written files are waited on until mtime is at least 2 seconds old.
generators.provenance: SHA256 of the generate.py that was executed, of records jsonl, and of truth jsonl. Sibling directories are not modified.

label_prior_calibration.data: Counts of (machine type, payout index) on the real TRAIN windows used for the fit, and the same counts on synthetic windows. Validation is not used.
label_prior_calibration.formula: Per type, p = (count + alpha) / sum(count + alpha). w = clip(p_train / p_synth, 0.25, 4). Then divide w by sum(p_synth * w) so the smoothed synthetic prior has mean weight 1. Types with no synthetic labels keep weight 1. Real slots keep weight 1.
label_prior_calibration.meaning: This only rebalances the synthetic class prior toward the public train type-conditional payout marginal. It does not claim new information and does not fit the generator.

reporting.promote_seeds: Report both seeds and spread = max(tune_R) - min(tune_R). That spread is not a confidence interval and is not a significance test.
reporting.ranking: After the screen, freeze research/screen_ranking.json. Family rank is the lowest tune_R among its completed screen mixes, then lower train_loss_mean, then family name. Promote the top 2 families. Re-run both mixes at 300 steps for seeds 0 and 1, plus a real-only control on that same budget.
reporting.time: Do not start a trial that cannot finish before the deadline given the observed seconds per step. The first real-only screen trial and the first available family's 25% and 50% mixes are started as soon as that family ingests, before the other families finish.

artifacts: Each trial directory holds config.json, metrics.json, log.txt, manifest.json, and checkpoint.pt. Checkpoints stay under this research directory. Every JSON states eligibility RESEARCH_ONLY and eligibility_status unresolved.
